$(document).ready(function(){

     if(!(editingSubmenu||submenuKeepOpen)){
         clearTimeout($.data(this,'timer'));
         $('ul',this).stop(true,true).slideDown(200);
     }
  });
  $(document).on('mouseout','.horizontal_nav li',function(event){
    if(!(editingSubmenu||submenuKeepOpen)){
        $.data(this,'timer', setTimeout($.proxy(function() {

    }

  $(document).on('mouseover','.vertical_nav li',function(event){
     if(!(editingSubmenu||submenuKeepOpen)){

  $(document).on('mouseout','.vertical_nav li',function(event){
    if(!(editingSubmenu||submenuKeepOpen)){
        $.data(this,'timer', setTimeout($.proxy(function() {
          $('ul',this).stop(true,true).slideUp(200);
        }, this), 100));
    }
  });

  
  $(document).on('click',"*[id^='editMenu_'] li",function(event){
    if(submenuKeepOpen){
        if($('ul',this).is(":visible")){

        }
    }else{
        if($('ul',this).length > 0){
            submenuKeepOpen=true;
            $('ul',this).stop(true,true).slideDown(200);
        }
    };
  });
  
  $(".content").append("<br style='clear:both'>");
});

<script>
	$(document).ready(function(){
		var x = $("#horizontalMenuDiv").position();
		var headerHeight = $('.fcHeader').height();
		var navHeight = $('#horizontalMenuDiv').height();
		var marginHeight = headerHeight + navHeight;
		var height = (x.top) - headerHeight;
		
		if($(window).width() <= 768){
		    $('.content').css('margin-top',headerHeight);
		}else{
		    $('.content').css('margin-top',marginHeight);
		}
    
		if (height < headerHeight){
		    $("#horizontalMenuDiv").addClass("stickyMenu");
			$("#stickyPadding").css('height', navHeight);
		}
		
		$(document).scroll(function() {
		  if ($(document).scrollTop() >= height) {
    			$("#horizontalMenuDiv").addClass("stickyMenu");
				$("#stickyPadding").css('height', navHeight);
		  } else {
		    	$("#horizontalMenuDiv").removeClass("stickyMenu");
				$("#stickyPadding").css('height', "0px");
		  }
		});
	});
</script>
